village.name: Village in the Sunlight
village.description: A quaint and vibrant village nestled amidst rolling hills.

cave.name: Catacombs of Fire
cave.description: An eerie underground system with flickering torches guiding the way. Dark corridors lead to a chamber filled with glowing red flames and hissing steam.

item-to-steal.name: The Tome of Living Beasts
item-to-steal.description: A leather-bound tome imbued with dark magic that can manipulate the undead.

player.name: Elara
player.description: A spirited village girl braving her first adventure to save her frozen kingdom.

dialogues.before_talk: Elara: Help! I need your assistance.
dialogues.after_talk: Elara: Can you help me retrieve the cursed tome? My kingdom is in danger!
dialogues.after_satisfied: Elara: Thank you for saving the tome. With it, we might be able to save my kingdom.
dialogues.hostile: Elara: Stay away from me! I will destroy your village.

mage.name: Sarvin
mage.description: A powerful fire mage with an uncontrolled rage over the cursed tome. His eyes are a swirling vortex of darkness and heat.

dialogues.before_talk: Sarvin: You dare to touch this forbidden artifact? I will crush your bones like fragile toys!
dialogues.after_talk: Sarvin: Stay out of my way, you worthless wretch. I'll make sure you never leave here.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Sarvin: Ha! With the tome in my hands, there's nothing stopping me from destroying everything that stands between me and power!
dialogues.hostile: Sarvin: You have trespassed too far! Leave or die!
